subject: Request: one-time POC credit & evaluation window extension for BlueMap Health
thread_body:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@bluemaphealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@bluemaphealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: RE: POC timeline and outstanding questions

Thanks Jonas — quick update from our side.

The clinical team is happy with the early results but legal needs a longer runway to finalize the DPA and procurement has a hard stop on PO processing until next quarter (starts 6/15).

Real ask: can Redwood extend the evaluation window by 30 days and provide an additional $15k of complimentary credits to cover our expanded test cases (EHR ingestion, nightly syncs)? If you can grant that one-time concession it will allow us to continue the pilot without interruption and get finance across the line for the PO.

I can escalate internally but wanted to check your side first.

— Ellen
Director of Clinical Programs
BlueMap Health

--- original message ---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@bluemaphealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 16:42:00 -0400
Subject: POC plan + next steps (BlueMap)

Appreciate the time today. Attached is the updated POC plan and a short SOW with milestones (see attachments). Key items for your team:
- Baseline performance report (week 2)
- Data handling and retention appendix
- Access plan for engineering sandbox

Per our standard PLG terms we include $10k of complimentary credits and a 30-day evaluation window. If procurement needs more runway or credits we can route for an exception — happy to coordinate.

Attachments: POC_Plans_v2.pdf, SOW_draft_BlueMap.docx

Best,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

------------------------------
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 May 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval request — BlueMap one-time POC uplift and 30d extension

Team — forwarding Ellen's ask. Summary: BlueMap needs +30 days and an incremental $15k credits (on top of standard $10k) to cover EHR ingestion and larger syncs while procurement processes the PO. They are a strategic mid-market health customer with potential to convert to Dedicated in H2.

Why this matters:
- Clinical signoff is positive; the pilot is production-adjacent and will likely generate revenue once PO clears.
- Procurement window mismatch (internal timing) — the risk is we lose momentum and the clinical team shifts to an alternate vendor.
- Incremental cost to Redwood is primarily token spend; we have mechanisms to monitor abuse and expire credits after scope.

Request: One-time approval for $15,000 additional complimentary credits + extend evaluation window by 30 days (new total trial window = 60 days). Include standard guardrails: credits expire 30 days after extension ends, usage limited to the BlueMap project namespace, and engineering rate-limits enforced.

Related items: deal id BM-2028-0427; HubSpot thread https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567; attachments attached.

Asks: Aditya — can you approve from exec budget? Chloe — can you confirm legal guardrails (DPA addendum language) can be enforced for a temporary window? Marissa — stand by to update success plan and enable CS check-ins.

Thanks,
Jonas

------------------------------
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 May 2028 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — BlueMap one-time POC uplift and 30d extension

Jonas — after reviewing the account health and pipeline signal I'm OK to approve the one-time concession with the following firm limits:
- $15,000 one-time credits (non-recurring)
- 30 day extension applied from today (total trial 60 days max)
- Credits to be consumed only by the BlueMap project id (we'll set the project tag)
- Finance will flag this as a non-standard concession; CS should capture conversion evidence for ROI tracking

Chloe, please update the short DPA addendum and loop legal if anything looks off. Marissa — partner with Jonas on the success checklist and make sure we have a single exec sponsor on their side.

Aditya Rao
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

------------------------------
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@bluemaphealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@bluemaphealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 May 2028 18:03:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Request: one-time POC credit & evaluation window extension for BlueMap Health

Ellen — good news. Leadership has approved a one-time extension: $15,000 in additional complimentary credits and a 30-day extension to the evaluation window.

Next steps:
1) Chloe will send a 1-paragraph DPA addendum and the amended SOW. Please review and sign; the credit will be loaded once the addendum is returned.
2) Procurement: we understand your PO timeline; this will hold the pilot active for 30 more days from today (expiry 2028-06-26). The credits expire 30 days after the extension ends.
3) CS/Success plan: Marissa will reach out to set the check-ins and milestones to ensure conversion evidence is captured.

Attachments: DPA_addendum_BlueMap_1p.docx (sent by Chloe)

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the pilot.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
